title: PROPOSED soroban [expect] block: simulation-resource-estimate
$comment: NOT AUTHORITATIVE, and deliberately not reachable from schemas/fixture-v1.schema.json. This file is a proposal for a new soroban assertion kind, staged ahead of the engine support it requires. CONTRIBUTING.md#fixture-schema makes StellarCanary/Protocol-Canary's loader authoritative and forbids this repository's schema from leading it: adding this kind to fixture-v1.schema.json today would make the schema accept a fixture that canary-soroban rejects, and canary-runner's scheduler aborts the whole run (exit 4) on such a fixture rather than skipping it. This fragment becomes part of fixture-v1.schema.json only once canary-soroban ships and releases the matching SorobanAssertion variant. Tracked by ProtocolCanary-Fixtures#301; the engine prerequisite is Protocol-Canary#517 / #504. Bounds below are XDR field widths from stellar-xdr v28.0 (Stellar-transaction.x): SorobanTransactionData.resourceFee is int64, and SorobanResources.instructions / diskReadBytes / writeBytes are uint32. Validated by tests/test_sim_resource_fixtures.py using tools/validate/jsonschema_lite.py.

kind.description: Simulation must succeed AND its resource estimate must satisfy every bound declared alongside this key. Omitted bounds are not asserted.

min_resource_fee_at_least.description: Lower bound on the response's minResourceFee, parsed as a decimal integer. Bounded by int64, the width of SorobanTransactionData.resourceFee.

min_resource_fee_at_most.description: Upper bound on minResourceFee. Must be >= min_resource_fee_at_least when both are present; JSON Schema cannot express that, so tests/test_sim_resource_fixtures.py checks it.

instructions_at_least.description: Lower bound on SorobanResources.instructions decoded from the response's transactionData. Bounded by uint32.

instructions_at_most.description: Upper bound on SorobanResources.instructions. Must be >= instructions_at_least when both are present.

disk_read_bytes_at_least.description: Lower bound on SorobanResources.diskReadBytes. Zero is meaningful here: a pure read of an already-loaded contract instance must not need disk-backed reads.

write_bytes_at_most.description: Upper bound on SorobanResources.writeBytes. Zero is meaningful for a read-only invocation.

footprint_read_only_count.description: Exact length of LedgerFootprint.readOnly decoded from transactionData. Stable for a fixed function on a fixed contract, unlike the fee and instruction estimates.

footprint_read_write_count.description: Exact length of LedgerFootprint.readWrite decoded from transactionData.

resource_fee_matches_min_resource_fee.description: SorobanTransactionData.resourceFee inside transactionData must equal minResourceFee. Only `true` is expressible: `false` would assert that the host returns two contradictory estimates.
